answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the willow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the karst of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wharf re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
